[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Payout form: mirror Farm/Plot/Program filters into the URL (dapp_beta #147)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dapp_beta/pull/147
  
  Details:
  Governor request (Gary, 2026-09-29): on beta.dapp.truesight.me/report_payout_event.html, changing the Farm / Plot / Program filters should also update the URL so the filtered view is shareable/bookmarkable.
  
  Shipped in dapp_beta PR #147 (merged, sha d149729):
  
  - payout-event-utils.js — pure helpers filterUrlParams() (emits only NON-DEFAULT facets so a pristine link stays clean) + parseFilterUrl() (absent key => default; ?program= honored as explicit empty) + FILTER_URL_KEYS.
  - report_payout_event.html — setUrlFilterParams() (history.replaceState; touches only farm/plot/program, composes with existing ?tx=/?tree_id= deep links) + tryApplyUrlFilters() (applies ?farm=&plot=&program= once both SSOTs load; silently ignores facets the data cannot offer). Wired to the 3 change handlers, post-SSOT-load, and resetForm.
  - tests/payout-event-utils.test.js — +7 unit tests (payout-event-utils 132/132; full unit suite EXIT=0).
  - tests/report_payout_event.spec.ts — +2 Playwright tests (URL mirror; deep-link restore).
  
  Bonus fix (found while isolating a local test failure): the Playwright mock globs were **/sunmint/plots/index.geojson, but the page actually fetches .../sunmint/main/plots/index.geojson — the glob could never match, so Playwright's catch-all {} won and the farm dropdown stayed empty. That is why the pre-existing FARM/PLOT test (spec line 999) failed locally. Widened the globs to **/plots/index.geojson / **/farms/index.json; all 3 filter tests now pass.
  
  Gates: beta only. No dapp_prod promotion, no payout fired.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
